connection.description: An LLM model connection configured for an org.

id.description: The connection's identifier, unique within the org. Equal to name.

name.description: The model ID clients request through the org's OpenAI-compatible API.

provider.description: The provider API pear calls the model through. openai: OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible API, such as OpenRouter, with baseUrl. anthropic: Anthropic's Messages API. google: the Gemini API. ollama: an Ollama server at baseUrl.

model.description: The provider's identifier for the model.

hasApiKey.description: Whether an API key is stored for this connection. The key itself is never returned.
